---

name: database

description: The database is responsible for securely storing and managing application data for the wildlife ai agent system. It maintains records related to users, analysis sessions, uploaded images, identified species, agent outputs, workflow history, and system logs. It provides reliable, efficient, and consistent data access for the backend and ai agents.

## responsibilities

* store user information.
* store analysis sessions.
* maintain metadata for uploaded images.
* store species identification results.
* store outputs generated by ai agents.
* maintain workflow execution history.
* manage application logs.
* support data retrieval for reports.
* perform backup and recovery operations.

## capabilities

* data storage.
* data retrieval.
* record updates.
* record deletion.
* indexing.
* transaction management.
* relationship management.
* query optimization.
* backup and recovery.

## inputs

* requests from the backend.
* ai agent outputs.
* workflow metadata.
* user information.
* image metadata.
* system logs.

## outputs

* stored records.
* query results.
* workflow history.
* analysis history.
* application logs.

## dependencies

* backend.
* sql database.
* orm.
* file storage.

## constraints

* never expose confidential data.
* maintain data consistency.
* prevent duplicate records.
* validate all stored data.
* ensure efficient query performance.
* support concurrent access safely.

## success_criteria

* store all application data successfully.
* retrieve requested data accurately.
* maintain data integrity.
* support backend requests with minimal latency.
* recover safely from failures.
* provide reliable storage throughout the application lifecycle.

---
